identify_intro.title: Identify the Reef
identify_intro.body: Tap a species you can see in this photo. Your identification helps real scientists studying Caribbean reefs.

goal_intro.title: Rebuild the Target
goal_intro.body: Check the objective card to see which coral this mission needs. Your reef health climbs as you grow the target coral toward its goal.

feed_action.title: Use a Fish Action
feed_action.body: Feed a helpful fish to boost the reef. Each turn gives you a limited number of actions, so spend them where they help most.

egg_intro.title: New Hatchling
egg_intro.body: A breeding event! Tap the egg to hatch it, then drag the fish into your reef.

end_turn_action.title: End the Turn
end_turn_action.body: Press End Turn. Your fish will help the coral grow — one turn is all you need.

results_intro.title: Read the Reef Check
results_intro.body: After each turn, the reef check shows what improved and what still needs work. Use it to decide your next move.

win_outro.title: Mission Complete
win_outro.body: You rebuilt the reef and banked the reward. Keep the sanctuary healthy, then head back to the route for the next site.
